paras: Menetia alanae, also known commonly as Alana's menetia and the  Top End dwarf skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Australia.
The specific name, alanae (genitive, feminine) is in honor of Australian herpetologist Alana Young.
M. alanae is found in Northern Territory in Australia.
The preferred natural habitats of M. alanae are forest and savanna.
M. alanae is a small, long-tailed skink. It may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 29 mm (1.1 in). The tail is 1.3 times SVL.
